changelog.summary: Join an owner-accepted priced SaaS offer to current, approved seller guidance without making unsupported claims or sending outreach.

title: Offer to Seller Readiness
description: Join an owner-accepted priced SaaS offer to current, approved seller guidance without making unsupported claims or sending outreach.
setup_prompt: Use Offer to Seller Readiness as a chat-led proposal. Inspect existing Crews, source permissions, exact subject, owner and action policy. Propose reuse or reviewed creation, typed handoffs, a real manual first case and separate approval for consequential actions. Show the plan before Builder applies it. Selection enables no write or recurrence.

setup_inputs.label: One offer, plan, price revision and buyer persona with protected customer contracts and a named pricing and enablement owner.
Read current billing price and entitlement revisions, unit-cost evidence, approved product claims and dated buyer objections.
Pricing owner accepts the exact offer; Enablement removes stale prices and unsupported claims before a separate content review.
Accountable source, decision and action owners
Authorized connections or equivalent current exports
Manual-only or reviewed event and schedule policy
